accountPage.title: Your Nowly account
accountPage.description: Manage the devices linked to your account, your data and your sign-in.
accountPage.sign-in-description: An account is optional. It lets the extension sync your presences and settings between your browsers.
accountPage.devices-description: Browsers where the extension is connected to this account.
accountPage.unlink-confirm: This browser will stop syncing with your account. Its local data stays on it.
accountPage.data-description: Download everything Nowly keeps for this account, or delete the account. Deleting it erases the synced copy and unlinks your devices.
accountPage.delete-confirm: This permanently deletes your Nowly account and the synced copy of your extension. This cannot be undone.
accountPage.local-note: Data stored by the extension on your devices is not affected. You can erase it from the extension settings.
accountPage.action-error: We could not complete this request. Try again, or contact support if the problem continues.
accountPage.presences-description: Presences installed in the extensions linked to this account, as last synced.
accountPage.creations-description: Presences you made with the creator and sent for review.
accountPage.creations-empty: You have not sent any creation yet.
accountPage.public-description: Show a profile on nowly.me with the presences you made and the ones you like. It stays off until you turn it on.
accountPage.public-error-invalid: The bio or one of the links is not valid.
accountPage.public-privacy: Only what is on this page becomes public. Your activity, devices and email never are.
accountPage.public-handle-auto: Your address is created from your Discord username when you save.
accountPage.custom-activities-description: Custom activities created in your extensions, as last synced.
accountPage.devices-unlink-all-confirm: Every linked browser will stop syncing with your account. You stay signed in here.
accountPage.public-links-hint: Add up to {max} https links (X, GitHub, your website...). The icon is picked from the site.

extensionConnectPage.sign-in-description: Nowly only reads your Discord name, avatar and email address. Your activity never goes through our servers.
extensionConnectPage.connect-description: Your Nowly extension will be linked to the account {name}.
extensionConnectPage.done-description: Your extension is connected. You can close this tab and go back to Nowly.
extensionConnectPage.not-detected-description: Open this page in the browser where Nowly is installed, or install the extension first.
extensionConnectPage.error-description: Select Try again to restart this step. If the problem continues, contact support.
extensionConnectPage.mismatch-description: The extension is signed in with a different Nowly account than this session ({name}). Switch account to authorize the right one.
extensionConnectPage.forbidden-description: Only moderators and administrators can connect the extension with admin access. Sign in with another account or go back.
extensionConnectPage.perm-name: See your Discord name, avatar and email
extensionConnectPage.perm-private: Your activity never goes through our servers
extensionConnectPage.perm-creator: Publish custom activities under your name
extensionConnectPage.perm-revoke: Stay connected until you unlink the device

submissionPage.title: Submission
submissionPage.description: Preview the presence, follow what changed and talk with the reviewers.
submissionPage.action-error: We could not complete this request. Try again, or contact support if the problem continues.
submissionPage.not-found: This submission does not exist or you cannot see it.
submissionPage.sign-in-description: Sign in with the account that sent the submission, or with a moderator account.
submissionPage.pull-request-error: The pull request could not be opened yet. It will be retried.
submissionPage.publish-confirm: Publish this revision? The presence will go to the pull request and the library.
submissionPage.author: Author
submissionPage.changes-description: What each revision changed compared with the previous one.
submissionPage.files-description: The files the server built from the definition. These are the files that would be published.
submissionPage.thread-description: Reviews, comments and status changes, oldest first.
submissionPage.review-description: Your decision applies to the revision you see here.
submissionPage.comment-add: Add a comment on a field
submissionPage.error-stale: This submission changed while you were reviewing. The page was reloaded, check it and try again.
submissionPage.error-forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

staff.announcements-window-invalid: The end must be after the start.
staff.announcements-list-description: Edit, pin or remove what is already published.
staff.announcements-retranslate-hint: Changing the English text translates the other languages again.
staff.announcements-delete-description: It disappears for every user and cannot be restored.

staff.announcements-kind-warning-hint: Important notice, shown with a warning
staff.announcements-placeholder-description: A short summary shown in the banner
staff.announcements-placeholder-content: Details shown when the announcement is opened

staff.sec-texts-desc: Descriptions and the languages they ship in.

staff.decision-request_changes-hint: The author fixes the flagged points and resubmits.
staff.decision-reject-hint: The submission is closed with your reason.
